Grade 12 · Engineering Design · Practice Trial

THE DIRECTIONS

You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.

The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.

The score sheet

THE SCENE

Your engineering class is holding a practice trial. The school must choose how to cool a new study room. One side wants air conditioners. Your side wants a wind tower. Four people each have one result for the score sheet.

THE HISTORY

This trial is about a design from Yazd, Iran. For hundreds of years, tall wind towers caught the wind. They pulled cool air down into homes. Many still work today with no electricity.
